title: A Drone That Steers With Just One Motor
description: Maker Joshua Bird built a small drone that hovers and steers with one motor and a hinged propeller hub, with no servos or tail rotor. It only flies indoors, where an infrared beacon gives it a heading. Code and CAD files are open on GitHub.

beats.text: A drone with only one motor?
beats.vo: This drone steers in every direction with just one motor.

Maker Joshua Bird used a hinged propeller hub. When the motor speeds up and slows down very fast, the blades change angle, so timed surges tilt the drone. A standard speed controller could not keep up, and it only flies indoors, where an infrared beacon tells it which way is forward.
Follow for a daily dose of engineering.

caption:
A drone that steers with just ONE motor. 🚁
Maker Joshua Bird's hinged propeller hub changes blade angle as the motor speeds up and slows down, so timed surges tilt the drone. Limits: indoor only, with an infrared beacon for heading. Code and CAD are open source.
Why care: fewer parts, harder control.
